gaps.lead: The athlete insisted that she had never taken banned substances.
gaps.explanation: deny having + past participle denies an earlier action.

gaps.lead: Everyone thought the concert was excellent.
gaps.explanation: 'Everyone thought it excellent' → 'made an excellent impression on everyone'.

gaps.lead: I can't wait to see you again.
They have accused the mayor of corruption.
gaps.explanation: Active 'they have accused him of' becomes passive: has been accused of.

gaps.lead: There's a rumour that the factory will close.
She prefers reading books to watching television.
gaps.explanation: prefer X to Y = would rather do X than do Y.
